ma rgyud snying po don gsum gyi mchod pa'i las rim gyi zur 'debs mdor bsdus las/thog mar brgyud 'debs ni/khyab bdag kun bzang dpal ldan rdo rje

tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250ma rgyud snying po don gsum gyi mchod pa'i las rim gyi zur 'debs mdor bsdus las/ thog mar brgyud 'debs ni/1$0000300 khyab bdag kun bzang dpal ldan rdo rje sems// las kyi dbang mo rje btsun thod phreng rtsal// ye shes mtsho rgyal 'jam mgon khri lde'i zhabs// bkra shis stobs rgyal rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang*// don grub bkra shis chos dbyings rang sar grol// rdo rje thogs med padma phrin las nas// gsang ba kun bdag mdo sngags gling pa'i bar// rim byon rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha// mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can gter srung la// gsol ba 'debs so ma rgyud gsang ba'i lam// snying po don gsum nyams len mthar phyin nas// tshe 'dir rtsa gsum kun 'dus mchog la reg /srid gsum rdo rje gsum du sbyor byed shog /

bgegs bskrad spro na/ hrī: gnyis 'dzin snang ba'i log 'dren 'byung po'i tshogs: 'di ru ma gnas rang rang so sor dengs: gang dag mi 'gro khro tshogs 'bar ba yis: brlag 'gyur gsang ba chos sku'i ye mtshams bcad: hrīḥphaṭa: skyabs sems rjes su mchod pa byin rlabs spro na/ snying po kun 'dus dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i rdzas: phyi nang gsang ba'i rang byung mchod pa rnams: ma dag log 'khrul nyes pa'i tshogs rnams kun: ye shes 'bru gsum sbyangs zhing byin gyis brlabs: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ de nas byin 'bebs la 'jug go /tshogs rdzas bsang chu dang bdud rtsis bran la/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum brjod/ hūm̐/ padma 'od dang 'og min gnas// zla gam dbang gi pho brang nas// snying po don gyi rtsa gsum lha// 'khor bcas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hūm̐/ 'dod yon lnga ldan tshogs mchod sprin// nam mkha' gang ba legs spros te// rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// mchod bzhes dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ gu ru dhe ba ḍā ki nī tsaṇḍa lī yai de ba ḍā ki nī sarba dharmā pā la sa pa ri bā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ rtsa gsum skong gso spyi 'gre gtang zhing tshogs la rol/ lhag ma ni/ byin brlabs la/ hūm̐/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro yi// spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas pa// gsang sngags bka' yi srung ma rnams// lhag ma'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bstan pa rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod/ oṃ utstshiṣṭa ba liṃ ta bhakṣe bhyaḥswā hā/ chad tho ni/ hūm̐/ sngon tshe dpal gyi gnas rnams su// rtsa ba gsum gyi spyan snga ru/ khas blangs dam nos srung ma'i tshogs// sngon gyi zhal bzhes ji bzhin du// rjes 'jug rig 'dzin sgrub pa pos// ji ltar bsgo ba'i las bsgrub cing*// mchod gtor 'di bzhes phrin las mdzod// brtan skyong ni/ bod skyong brtan ma 'khor bcas rnams// bshal chu bka' yi pham phab bcas// bdud rtsir byin brlabs 'di bzhes la// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod//

dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐/ rtsa gsum kun 'dus snying po'i lha tshogs kyis// 'dir 'dus rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag la// thun mong yid bzhin tshe dang bla med mchog /'dod dgur spyod pa'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ siddhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ rjes mchod bstod ni/ hūm̐/ rtsa gsum lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod tshogs 'bul// nyams chag 'gal 'khrul mthol lo bshags// sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bstod/ ma hā pañtsa rakta ba liṃ ta khā hi/ nongs bshags/ brtan bzhugs/ bsdu ldang*/ shis brjod/ bsngo smon spyi ltar bya/ zhes pa'ang blo gros mtha' yas kyis stabs bder btus pa dge legs 'phel// //
